Net new homes completed: 4,520 a year on average in 2016–2020, 2,794 a year in 2021–2025 (-38.2%).
5,253 affordable homes out of 13,969 completed in 2021–2025, i.e. 37.6%.
The city’s pipeline holds 190 unfinished projects for 10,100 affordable homes (66 of them 100% affordable projects).
41.5% of the pipeline’s affordable homes are in three neighbourhoods: Bayview Hunters Point (1,533), Financial District/South Beach (1,358), Mission (1,300).
Eviction notices filed: 2,091 in 2015, a low of 778 in 2020, 1,495 in 2025.
In the study area (SoMa, Mission, Tenderloin), 5 of the 95 unfinished affordable projects (68 homes) lie in the 100-year storm flood risk zone (2022).
